text:
anna: quick heads-up — hitting numeric instability + perf regression with the fp8 paged-attn kernel on canary (seq=2048, batch=8). saw a handful of steps with `inf` logits then automatic fallback to bf16 which spikes tail latency. repro and profiler below.

ravi: ugh. any stderr / trace? could be kv alignment + blocked tiling.

anna: paste of the short log: `step 142: logits contains inf -> falling back to bf16-variant; latency jump 4.2x`

anna: quick cpu/gpu top: GPU mem ok, sm utilization high, but strange jitter in attention kernel time.

perfbot: profiler summary (canary-2026-03-17):
```
kernel: paged_flash_fp8_v2  - avg 12.3ms (p90 35.1ms)
kernel: paged_flash_bf16_v1 - avg 28.9ms (p90 29.8ms)
softmax stage: outsamples show NaN spikes at ~seq 1500
kv cache hit-rate: 98.6% but misaligned stride detected on calls from model-runner v0.9.7
```

lia: @anna can you share the exact kernel selector flags used by canary? also any batch-merging heuristics enabled?

anna: selector flags: `attention.selector=auto`, `prefetch.kv=true`, `batch.merge=true`, `fp8.mode=dynamic` — canary used runtime defaults from deploy-2026-03-10.

marc: hypothesis: fp8 quantization + tiny softmax epsilon -> underflow/overflow when qscale adapts across KV boundaries. paged attention reorders slices and qscale drift can make exp blow up.

ravi: makes sense. we saw similar when page boundary qscales were out-of-sync after merging small requests. should we clamp logits before softmax? small epsilon helps.

anna: tried local patch: insert max clamp + eps adjust before softmax. quick diff: `logits = clamp(logits, -1e4, 1e4); logits = logits - max(logits); softmax = exp(logits + eps)`

anna: local run (fp8 paged-attn v2): no infs, latency p95 slightly up (~8%), end-to-end throughput stable.

lia: tradeoff acceptable for now but we need automated kernel fallback rules. proposer: if fp8 softmax infs > 0 in 1% of batches, switch to bf16 for remainder of request and report metric.

marc: simpler: make kernel selector check a softmax-stability probe during warmup window (first N tokens). if instability > threshold, pin bf16 for that session. also add adaptive epsilon per-page based on qscale variance.

ravi: can reproduce with this tiny reproducer (call from model-runner):
```
python -c "from runner import Client; c=Client(flags='attention.selector=auto,fp8.mode=dynamic'); print(c.run('x'*1800, batch=8))"
```

ravi: attaching failing seed + model hash to bug: model:redwood/llama2-13b-qlora@sha256:abc123..., seed=42, input len 1800.

perfbot: created perf-ticket RED-9832 (assigned=eng-runtime, priority=high) with attached trace and canary logs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for release/2026-03-10 -> reverted paged-attn-fp8-v2 on 3 hosts.

anna: next steps I propose: 1) add softmax-stability probe to selector (warmup tokens=64) 2) implement per-page adaptive-epsilon (start 1e-5 -> scale with qvar) 3) add telemetry for page qscale drift 4) run a 12h canary with these knobs on low traffic.

lia: +1. also add a short eval: run 5000 samples across seq 512..4096 to ensure no quality regressions introduced by epsilon clamping.

marc: i'll draft a PR for selector changes and small kernel clamp. will include flag: `attention.softmax_eps_mode=adaptive` and `attention.softmax_eps_base=1e-5`.

anna: thanks — assigning followups in RED-9832. ping me on thread for quick sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
